81367: Shiroe, the main protagonist of the series, was an engineering grad student before the Apocalypse. He's one of the most experienced and skillful adventurers in the game, due to having started playing Elder Tale when he was in middle school.
81369: A highly skilled level 90 adventurer who met Shiroe and Naotsugu shortly after the Apocalypse. Shiroe gave her the appearance changing potion (which allowed her character to look more like her real self); before that, she had been playing as a male character.
81371: Naotsugu is a friend of Shiroe. He believes that every man is a pervert, either openly or secretly. Thus, he prides himself for being an "open pervert", freely sharing his perverted thoughts about women with everyone.
81373: Nyanta is an old friend of Shiroe, as he also used to be a member of the Debauchery Tea Party. He's the one who protected Serara while she was trapped in the city of Susukino. He considers himself a "gentleman"; his weapon of choice is the rapier which he can double-wield.
88376: Guild master of Crescent Moon Alliance. She's overly-friendly with everyone she meets, especially Naotsugu.
88377: She works directly under Marielle and loves everything that's cute.
88378: She is saved by Nyanta in her time of need, and calls her guild for help. However, her guild would take to long to get to her location, so Shiroe and his group go in their stead.
88379: He has strong feelings for Marielle and will assist her in any way he can.
88380: Often argues with Shouryuu over trivial matters.
88386: Isaac, also known as Black Sword Isaac, is the guild master of Black Sword Knights. He is a Guardian and a member of the Round Table Alliance.
88388: Guild master of Merchant Guild Roderic.
88389: Kanami was the former leader of the now-disbanded Debauchery Tea Party before she moved to Europe and started a new account on the European servers.
88390: Works directly under Demikas. He wears a gray robe, which is an artifact drop from the Fire Lizard's Cave. As second in command, he leads the guild members on Demikas' behalf when they hesitate to take action against Shiroe's group.

88394: Lenessia is the grand daughter of Sergiatte Cowen and the princess to the throne.

88398: Guild master of Caravan of the West Wind. He was popular with girls even before the Apocalypse. Because Shiroe declined his offer to join his guild, he was led to believe Shiroe didn't like him. This is cleared up when Shiroe asks for his help.
88399: Takayama Misa is a level 90 Wolfman-Bard and a high-ranking member of D.D.D, the biggest battle guild in Akihabara. She acts as an adviser for Krusty.
88628: Tetra is one of the players trapped in the MMORPG Elder Tale.
135613: Seine is a Wolf Fang (Elf in the anime and later TRPG Replays) Swashbuckler-Border Patrol from the Log Horizon TRPG replay novels and is role-played by Ayasato Keiji.
158244: Michitaka is one of the players trapped in a the MMORPG Elder Tale. His character is a Human Monk-Blacksmith and he is the leader of the biggest production guild in Akihabara named Marine Organization, consisting of 2,500 members.
158245: Charasin, also known as Young Boss Charasin, is the guild master of Shopping District 8, one of the top three production guilds in Akihabara. He is a Human Summoner-Merchant and a member of the Round Table Alliance. His Overskill is Multi-Line.

194021: Regan is the Sage of Mirror Lake and a dedicated researcher on magic, especially World Class Magic.
